question: How long is the grace period on federal Direct student loans after you graduate, leave school, or drop below half-time enrollment?
true_claim_text: Direct student loans have a six-month grace period

source: U.S. Department of Education, Federal Student Aid: Direct Subsidized and Unsubsidized Loans have a 6-month grace period; the 9-month grace period applied to the discontinued Federal Perkins Loan program.
